infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bio-net India needs camera access to photograph biodiversity specimens for documentation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Bio-net India needs location access to record GPS coordinates of species sightings.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bio-net India needs microphone access to record audio notes and traditional knowledge.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Bio-net India to access your camera to photograph biodiversity.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Bio-net India to use your location to record GPS coordinates.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Bio-net India to record audio notes.
